rule_name: Delivered before the PO was raised
Invoice date outside the stated 2009-2011 window
Sales lines with no customer ID (cash / guest sales)
Admin postings excluded from demand (postage, fees, adjustments)
PO date unparseable (source holds "Date Not Captured" / "Pre-PQ Process")
Freight cost not numeric in source (text such as "Invoiced Separately")
SKUs not matched by the category rules (fall back to Other)
SKUs whose description varies across lines
Negative lead time excluded from supplier averages
